arguments.query: select sql from sqlite_master where type="table"

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(state||":"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b where status="pending"
select status,count(*) from outbox group by 1

select flight_id,capacity,price_cents,version,(select group_concat(key||"="||value) from cache) c,(select group_concat(flight_id||":"||price_cents||":"||until_step) from fare_holds) fh,(select step from episode_clock) st from flights
select flight_id,capacity,price_cents,version,(select group_concat(key||"="||value) from cache) c,(select group_concat(flight_id||":"||price_cents||":"||until_step) from fare_holds) fh from flights

select key,value from cache union all select flight_id,price_cents||":"||until_step from fare_holds union all select id||" "||path,status||" "||message from request_logs where service="pricing" and id>(select max(id)-8 from request_logs)
select id,status,substr(message,1,40) m,trace_id from request_logs where service="booking" and id>(select max(id)-14 from request_logs) order by id
select id,service,path,status,substr(message,1,60) m from request_logs where id>(select max(id)-22 from request_logs) order by id
